about_the_game:
"The evolution of war is replacing the person with a weapon by a weapon without a person."

Get a taste of true combat drone action! Ukrainian Fight Drone Simulator – Starter Edition is a public adaptation of a leading ultra-realistic FPV drone trainer, built on lessons from the Ukrainian frontline. Learn to fly like a frontline pilot, take on real-world mission scenarios, and feel the rush of modern FPV warfare.

! We recommend using an RC controller !

Any of the following models would be a great choice: Radiomaster Pocket, Radiomaster Zorro, Radiomaster TX12, TBS Tango 2, Radiomaster Boxer, Radiomaster TX15 or Radiomaster TX16S.

PS5 and Xbox gamepads are also supported!

Discover the following play modes:

1. ACADEMY MODE

Learn or enhance your skills in flying the most commonly used types of combat FPV drones.

This mode includes dozens of diverse missions in real-life combat zones.

Learn how to:

  • Plan and execute combat missions: select platform and loadout, set targets (vehicles, infantry, shelters), analyze their number, locations, weather, time of day, terrain, electronic warfare, etc.

  • Complete a pre-flight protocol following a real combat routine: verify components, ground station status, battery, communication type, and payload configuration.

  • Learn to think like a commander: anticipate route issues, controller conflicts, resource allocation, and actions under EW interference to complete missions successfully.

  • Here, you can also test the Race Mode to sharpen agility and precision.

Our courses:

  • Basic pilot course

  • Kamikaze

  • Bomber 

  • Air interceptor

2. BATTLEGROUND MODE

Defend your bunker against endless enemy waves: infantry, vehicles, tanks, and bikers. Each wave grows tougher, while your drones have limited ammo and recovery. Survive, earn points, and choose: fight to the end or evacuate to save your progress.

Available drones:

  • Recon drone 

  • Two kamikaze drones with different loadouts

  • Two bombers (12” and 15”) with various payloads

This mode helps you maintain top piloting skills after completing all training courses. Top the leaderboard, be the ace!

3. MULTIPLAYER - coming soon

Challenge other drone operators or join forces with teammates in realistic FPV combat missions.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Deep simulation: Precise calculations in physics, aerodynamics, and battery performance deliver an authentic, close-to-real flight experience.

  • Combat-proven drones: Angel Arrow 12”, Angel Arrow 15”, Mimic 3T, FPV Kamikaze Phantom 7–10”, LuckyStrike. 

  • Weapons and payloads: multiple bomb types, and modular attachments.

  • Mission planning: choose drones, analyze maps, read briefings, and configure payloads.

  • Dynamic environment: controlled dynamic weather and realistic day/night cycle.

  • EW System integration: electronic warfare simulations to train pilots in overcoming interference 

  • Flight controls: PID tuning.

Try the Ukrainian Fight Drone Simulator built by Ukraine’s drone veterans. Fly real battle missions, sharpen your drone mastery and train risk-free!
